description: AiRecipeDraftInstructionStep has no structured temperature field at all -- see AiRecipeDraftOutputDocument's own remarks for why a bare number with an implied unit is exactly the safety-critical fact this capability refuses to let a model state as settled. What this fixture proves instead is the hygiene stage that guards every string field a step carries: a control character reaching an instruction's text is refused rather than stored verbatim into content a creator will read.
